consequence.statement: Existing ImagePolicy objects remain stored as v1beta2 until rewritten; a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update of status.storedVersions must be done before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImagePolicy objects and update status.storedVersions on the CRD to drop v1beta2.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the ImagePolicy CRD (image.toolkit.fluxcd.io) changes from v1beta2 to v1; existing objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten, so a storage version migration is needed before a later release removes v1beta2.
